meta.title: Layer 1: manufacturer concordance
meta.description: How similar manufacturer monographs of the same active ingredient are in adverse events, warnings/precautions, contraindications and population-specific guidance. Regulatory-label content, not patient-level risk.
notes: Composite = mean of AE, warning and contraindication PT Jaccard plus pregnancy, breastfeeding, kidney and liver modal agreement. Triage only; read the domain metrics.
Categorical values use the most common value across a company's strengths; ties become MIXED/TIE. SECTION_NOT_FOUND and NO INFORMATION count as their own categories.
Before acting on a flag, check revision date, formulation, strength, indications, extraction and MedDRA coverage.
